notes.title: Update 1.09
notes.content: A small update today, that should fix a rare crash that occured when the game was not able to open the bones file. Also a new check to prevent random commander names from being generated that are too long.

notes.title: Update 1.07
notes.content:
I've uploaded a minor update to the game, in hopes of fixing a CTD with the following message:

"could not find any library for SDL2 (PYDSL2_DLL_PATH: unset)"

This update is compatible with saved campaigns from previous versions, the only change is the the directory of the SDL library is now explicity set during boot-up. You may have to restart Steam for it to download and apply the update.

notes.title: Armoured Commander 1 Available on Steam for Free
notes.content:
I realise as I write this that I haven't been keeping up with how Armoured Commander II has been doing since it hit Steam the other month. Turns out quite well - it's already on Version 5.2.6, and the developer has recently conducted a poll to figure out where to go next with this time and resources.

Meanwhile, the original Armoured Commander game that was released in 2017 has been thrown up on Steam, completely free. We originally wrote about it here, and it's a neat little game and well worth trying out if you haven't already. It's feature complete and as good as it can be, but there isn't going to be any further development done to it.

It's also worth noting that you can grab an early version of Armoured Commander II for free via the developer's official website. It's a build that's not being developed anymore, however, but if you want to 'try' ArmCom2 to see what it's like this is one way you can do that, as is trying out the original game.

notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content: Armoured Commander has been updated to version 1.06, which now uses Python 3 and SDL 2. Please do report any bugs or crashes in the discussion boards, as there still might be a few elements that need to be updated.

notes.title: Armoured Commander now available!
notes.content:
The original Armoured Commander game, released in 2017, is now available for free on Steam. At present the live version is 1.05, the same one as the final release three years ago.

I am working to update the game to use Python 3 and SDL 2, which will make it easier for me to make minor updates to it in the future. You can try out this version on the alpha-python3 branch.
